title: Mango Lassi Ice Pops
changes_from_base: Mango, yoghurt, honey and lime blended lassi-style replace the strawberries, sugar and jam.
summary: A frozen take on mango lassi, blending sweet mango with yoghurt and a touch of honey and lime.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Process 283 g chopped mango, 370 g yoghurt, 85 g honey and 1 tbsp lime juice together for 15 s.

steps.title: Smooth
steps.text: Scrape down the sides and process again until completely smooth, 15-30 s more.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Pour into a jug, fill six 90 ml moulds and add the sticks.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze for at least 6 h, up to 5 days.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Hold the moulds under warm water for 30 s to release the pops.

tips: Use ripe, sweet mango for the best flavour and colour.
Scrape down the sides thoroughly so there are no lumps of mango left in the mixture.
These aren't suitable for babies under 1 year, as they contain honey.
storage: Keep the pops in their moulds or wrapped individually in the freezer for up to 5 days.
